name: ChamberofCommerce.com

sources.title: FAQ (search-indexed) — claim an existing listing via 'Claim This Business' on the profile page, or use the Add Your Business page; paid Premium tier advertised at $399
Third-party guide — free basic listing with paid upgrades; ~45 min; requires genuine US business presence plus website/business verification; cites chamberofcommerce.com/faq

conditions: Free basic listing exists but the business may already be auto-listed from data-provider feeds — the free route is 'Claim This Business' on the existing profile or the Add Your Business form
Requires a genuine US business presence with verifiable business details — an online-only SaaS without a US business address/phone may not fit
Free listing shows competitor ads on your page; Premium (~$399, per site FAQ) removes ads and adds placement/website link prominence
requirements: US business presence; business name, address, phone, category, website
Verification of website and business details during claim/add
Unclaimed data-feed listings 'receive the lowest priority' until claimed
preparation: Search the directory first for the business — claim rather than duplicate
Consistent NAP (name, address, phone) matching other citations
Business categories (up to 5 additional categories is a paid feature)
Website URL and verification method access
workflow: Search chamberofcommerce.com for the business name
If listed: open the profile and click 'Claim This Business'; if not: use the Add Your Business page
Complete business details and verify website/ownership
Wait for review; decline the Premium upsell unless ad removal/top placement is wanted
Confirm the live profile page and website link treatment
watchFor: Site 403s automated fetches — use a browser
Free listings display ads and competitor businesses on your own profile page
Not affiliated with local chambers of commerce — it is a private directory despite the name
Data-feed duplicates are common; claim the canonical record rather than adding a new one
countsAsLive: A claimed business profile page is publicly viewable on chamberofcommerce.com with the correct name, address, phone, category and website link
unknowns: Whether the free tier's website link is dofollow or even shown (link prominence may be a premium feature)
Current review turnaround and verification method
Whether purely online SaaS businesses without a local presence are accepted
